sentences.en: You'd be surprised what you can learn in a week.
sentences.zh: 你一周之内能学到的东西会让你惊讶。

sentences.en: To be surprised, to wonder, is to begin to understand.
sentences.zh: 感到惊奇就是开始理解。

sentences.en: To my surprise, there were no people in the village.
sentences.zh: 令我惊讶的是，村子里一个人也没有。

collocations.zh: 惊 讶 地； 吃 惊 地
